text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam handed President Ben Ali a message from Syrian President Hafez al-Assad on the peace process and Syria's position on the negotiations with Israel. President Ben Ali asked Khaddam to carry a message to Assad expressing Tunisia's support for Syria.
- Tunisia and Libya to boost commercial exchanges.
- Active trade at retail stores ahead of Eid el-Fitr, mainly for clothes and cakes.
